title: How to Evangelize
description: A lesson on how to effectively share the gospel and guide people toward spiritual growth in Christ.

cards.heading: A Heart for Souls
cards.scriptureText: The harvest is plentiful but the workers are few.
cards.body: Evangelism begins with a heart that desires to see people come to know God. It is about loving people and wanting them to experience new life in Christ.
cards.question: How do you feel about sharing the gospel with others?

cards.heading: Pregnancy: Preparing the Heart
cards.body: Before someone receives new life in Christ, we must first prepare their heart. This happens through prayer, building relationships, meeting needs, inviting them, and overcoming rejection.
cards.question: Who is one person you can begin praying for and reaching out to?

cards.heading: Building Relationships
cards.scriptureText: I have become all things to all people so that by all possible means I might save some.
cards.body: Evangelism is not just speaking, it is connecting. Build genuine relationships, show care, and meet people where they are.
cards.question: How can you intentionally build a relationship with someone this week?

cards.heading: Labor: Sharing the Gospel
cards.scriptureText: I am not ashamed of the gospel, because it is the power of God that brings salvation.
cards.body: The goal is to clearly and courageously share the gospel. This is how people come to know Christ and experience new life.
cards.question: Are you ready to share the gospel when the opportunity comes?

cards.heading: The Gospel: God Loves Us
cards.scriptureText: For God so loved the world that he gave his one and only Son.
cards.body: God loves every person deeply and desires a relationship with them.
cards.question: How does knowing God loves people change the way you see them?

cards.heading: The Gospel: We Have Sinned
cards.scriptureText: For all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God.
cards.body: Every person has sinned and is separated from God. This is the problem that needs to be addressed.
cards.question: Why is it important to understand sin when sharing the gospel?

cards.heading: The Gospel: Sin Has Consequences
cards.scriptureText: For the wages of sin is death.
cards.body: Sin leads to spiritual death and separation from God. Without Christ, there is no solution.
cards.question: How can you explain the seriousness of sin in a loving way?

cards.heading: The Gospel: Jesus Saves
cards.scriptureText: While we were still sinners, Christ died for us.
cards.body: God demonstrated His love by sending Jesus to die for our sins so we can be forgiven and restored.
cards.question: What does Jesus’ sacrifice mean to you personally?

cards.heading: The Gospel: Our Response
cards.scriptureText: If you declare with your mouth, 'Jesus is Lord'... you will be saved.
cards.body: We must respond by repenting, believing in Jesus, and making Him Lord of our lives.
cards.question: How would you invite someone to respond to the gospel?

cards.heading: Nurture: Helping New Believers Grow
cards.scriptureText: Like newborn babies, crave pure spiritual milk.
cards.body: Evangelism does not end when someone receives Christ. New believers need care, teaching, encouragement, and prayer to grow.
cards.question: How can you help someone grow after they receive Christ?

cards.heading: Spiritual Family and Care
cards.body: Include new believers in a spiritual family where they can experience love, support, and encouragement.
cards.question: How can you help someone feel part of God’s family?

cards.heading: School: Growing in Knowledge
cards.scriptureText: Grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ.
cards.body: Help new believers continue growing by learning more about God. Teaching and discipleship strengthen their faith.
cards.question: What is one way you can help someone grow in their knowledge of God?

cards.heading: Next Steps
cards.scriptureText: Go and make disciples of all nations.
cards.body: Evangelism is a lifestyle. Continue reaching out, sharing the gospel, and helping others grow in Christ.
cards.question: Who will you start reaching out to this week?
